high_level_description: stc brand style, a video conference scene of a man speaking from a home office with a split-screen inset.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A home office with a light mint green wall decorated with framed red and blue pop art prints, a wooden shelf unit with a guitar and various items, and warm natural lighting.

elements.desc: A young man with dark curly hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt over a coral undershirt, hands clasped together at a wooden desk with a white coffee mug.
A smaller inset image of another man wearing glasses in the top right corner, split-screen video call composition.
